title: Component assembly, derivation, and open-input status of the $\alpha_{EM}$ fixed point
html:
Remark. Component assembly, derivation, and open-input status of the \alpha_{EM} fixed point

Proved results and assumptions

The fine-structure constant emerges as the symbolic root of a self-consistent fixed-point equation. This path is additive and self-consistent. The formulation avoids the refuted multiplicative Chern–Simons or gluon-octet forms.

The equation integrates three components. Only the third remains open:

  1. Tree term q\cdot[9]_q\cdot[10]_q: The bare inverse coupling from prop:em-coupling-projection. Lean verifies its categorical-trace refactoring (prop:alpha-em-categorical-trace-ratio).
  2. Zero-mode shift 2/(3\pi) = 2g/(4\pi(g-1))\big|_{g=4}: The photon infrared harmonic-1-form contribution on Bring's surface. Lean proves this in prop:photon-ir-zero-mode-bring. The normalization 8\pi = \pi b_1 = \pi\dim H^1(M_{\text{Bring}}) maintains the harmonic count.
  3. \mathcal{O}(\alpha^2) normalization H\cdot(1-h^2\alpha): The Habiro deformation (1-h^2\alpha) with coefficient H = [2]_q/(8\pi). Identifying the exact \mathcal{O}(\alpha^2) correction to H with a class in B_3(\mathbb{C}) is the single open input. The b3_normalization class field axiomatises this.

Genuine derivation, not projection

The class carries the hypothesis, and the theorem derives the conclusion. The lemma QOU.ArchimedeanUniverse.fixedPoint_iff_cubic establishes the equivalence between the fixed-point equation and the cubic root for \alpha \neq 0. The main theorem QOU.ArchimedeanUniverse.alpha_em_is_fixed_point_root composes this equivalence with the b3_normalization field. The proof is a genuine derivation.

Numerical context

At q_0, the tree term and zero-mode reproduce 1/\alpha to -4.2\times 10^{-6} (prop:em-coupling-bring-zero-mode). The \mathcal{O}(\alpha^2) self-consistency term supplies the residual \mathcal{O}(\alpha) correction. The conjectural B_3(\mathbb{C}) Bloch-class content supplies its exact form. The cubic P features a real root near 1/137.036. CODATA-consistency provides the empirical foundation of the conjecture.

Status

The sole open element remains the B_3(\mathbb{C}) \mathcal{O}(\alpha^2) normalization. Lean proves the tree/zero-mode assembly of T, the algebraic equivalence of the fixed-point, and the derivation of P(\alpha)=0. The class remains uninhabited. No fabricated instance attempts to close the primary conjecture.
